title: Run workers as Claude screens by default
notes:
A worker main dispatches with pane run is Claude Code in the pane's terminal unless main passes --screen (#218, workers-decision-5). Main's dispatch rule (src/main/workers/dispatch.ts) never mentions --screen, so in practice no worker runs as a screen. The trial's two blockers are settled: #224 found the gh pr create refusal does not reproduce, and #226 runs worker screens in the screen host so they outlive the app.

Change: pane run starts a Claude screen by default; --terminal asks for Claude Code in the terminal instead, and --screen stays accepted as a no-op so older prompts keep working. Parse in session-cli.ts, usage text there, and the dispatch rule in dispatch.ts updated to match. Windows has no screen host, so there a screen worker's turn ends with the app: say so in the usage text, or default to the terminal on Windows. Pick one and record it as a decision.

Out of scope: the agent a move into Ship starts, which stays as it is; a card of its own if it should follow.

Tests: the parse (default, --terminal, --screen) in session-cli's test. Docs: workers README scenarios, workers-decision-5 updated, history.

comments.body: Shipped in PR #227: pane run starts a Claude screen by default, --terminal asks for the terminal, --screen is still accepted, and --screen with --terminal is refused. Windows keeps the terminal by default (no screen host) and main's prompt says so there. workers-decision-5 records it.
